mechanics.claim: Only the third Determination stack triggers the bonus damage and heal; the bonus damage is a separate proc-damage instance from the triggering attack/strike.
mechanics.quote: The third stack {{tt|consumes them|See notes for consumption details}} all to deal {{as|{{pp|15 to 60 for 4|key=%|1 to 16|formula=15% + 15% every 5 levels}} AD}}

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage cannot critically strike.
mechanics.quote: The bonus damage cannot {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}}.

mechanics.claim: When applied by a basic attack, the bonus damage benefits from life steal.
mechanics.quote: The bonus damage benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

mechanics.claim: When applied by Wind Becomes Lightning, the bonus damage does not benefit from life steal, including W's own 33% lifesteal conversion.
mechanics.quote: Does not benefit from {{sti|life steal}}, including not healing from ''Wind Becomes Lightning's'' 33% conversion for this bonus damage.

mechanics.claim: Only Wind Becomes Lightning's first slash hit and its thrust can generate a Determination stack; subsequent slashes do not.
mechanics.quote: Only the initial slash of {{ai|Wind Becomes Lightning|Xin Zhao}} can generate a ''Determination'' stack. Slashes after the first do not count for stack generation.

mechanics.claim: Determination stacks (and thus the proc) are still gained even if the triggering attack is blocked (e.g. by spell shield).
mechanics.quote: Stacks of ''Determination'' will be gained even if the attack is {{tip|blocked}}.

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage from Wind Becomes Lightning can be blocked by spell shield, but the heal cannot; when applied by basic attack, neither the bonus damage nor the heal is blocked by spell shield.
mechanics.quote: The bonus damage will be blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}, the heal will not.

mechanics.claim: Only one enemy can be marked Challenged at a time; marking a new target removes the mark from the previous target.
mechanics.quote: Only one enemy can be marked as {{as|Challenged|buzzword}} at a time; applying the mark to a new target removes it from the previous one.
